title: Section Header
description: The SectionHeader molecule's authoring contract — the optional title, subtitle and description rendered above a block's content (packages/components/src/molecules/SectionHeader). Exposed as one grouped object definition so every block that renders a section header references it once, the fields stay grouped in the editor, and the delivered object spreads straight into the shared frontend component.
